item.tib: rje btsun chen po rgyal ba dbang ldan gyi rnam thar phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs bsam 'phel yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba yid kyi 'dod 'jo
item.coloph: brtsams pa'i byed po [three syllables are illegible] bdag / brtsams gnas dgon pa bde chen gling de la …
item.note: the author's name is supplied on the front page, but in the colophon the name seems to be written in a non-tibetan form. it is not sure whether this text belongs to vol. 31 or to vol. 32. although the text is marked as vol. no. 31, it is contained in vol. 32. this text has no apparent relevance in terms of its subject-matter to the contents of either vol. 31 or vol. 32.
